title: Pricing intake signal taxonomy and escalation path for enterprise billing requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable signal taxonomy and escalation path for non-bug enterprise pricing, packaging, and billing requests (commitments, invoicing adjustments, cost allocation, marketplace credits). Goal: reduce time-to-routing, improve first-touch accuracy, and codify SLAs for Finance, Sales, Marketplace, and Legal handoffs.
acceptance_criteria: Taxonomy implemented as a 6-signal classifier (revenue-exposure, contract-change, invoicing-correction, marketplace-partner, allocation-redistribution, product-packaging) documented and reviewed by Finance/Legal/SalesOps.
Routing matrix with primary and fallback owners for each signal published to the internal triage playbook.
Automated routing rules prototyped in the ticket intake form (Zendesk/Intercom) and validated on 100 recent requests with >=85% correct routing.
SLAs defined: initial acknowledgement within 24 business hours, resolution windows per signal (30 days high-exposure, 14 days medium, 7 days low) and tracked in the Console.
Metrics dashboard template for time-to-first-response, time-to-resolution, routing-accuracy and percentage of escalations created.
Training notes and example canned responses for frontline support and AEs included in the rollout pack.
routing_rules: If revenue_exposure >= $50,000 -> route to Finance (Billing Ops) AND notify Legal for potential contract amendment.
If request_type == 'contract_change' -> route to Legal -> Product -> Sales (escalation path: Legal owner must sign off before Finance action).
If request_origin == 'marketplace' or involves partner_fee_adjustment -> route to Marketplace Ops and Partner Success simultaneously.
If request involves retroactive invoice correction -> require "sample_invoices" attachment before Finance triage; set hold state until provided.
If routing confidence < 0.6 in automated classifier -> route to Triage Queue (Ops PM) for human review within 8 business hours.
Fallback: unrecognized signals route to Billing Ops with a tag 'needs-review' and 48h SLA for assignment.
triage_rubric: Revenue impact (weight 40%) — expected ARR/one-time credit amount or financial exposure.
Compliance & legal risk (weight 25%) — contract terms, regulatory constraints, data residency concerns.
Operational cost & effort (weight 20%) — engineering changes, manual accounting work, invoice re-issuance.
Strategic priority (weight 15%) — partner/strategic account, go-to-market impact, churn risk.
example_decisions: Example: $120k credit request tied to contract wording -> route to Legal + Finance, pause auto-resolution, escalate to VP Sales for approval.
Example: Marketplace partner overbilling due to fee misconfig (no contract change) -> Marketplace Ops handles, Finance issues partner credit, record in marketplace ledger.
Example: Small allocation redistribution (<$2k) -> Billing Ops auto-approve under delegated authority, update invoice metadata, closed in 7 days.
metrics_and_dashboard: volume by signal and channel (Sales, Support, Account Exec)
